messages.subject: variance explained by single QTL
messages.body_plain:
Hi Karl,

I was just wondering if there is a function that I could use to determine what percentage of variance is explained by a single QTL. If not, how would you go about calculating that statistic?

Thanks!

Sincerely,
Avni

messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl2-disc] variance explained by single QTL
messages.body_plain:
The only function that gives percent variance explained by a QTL is fitqtl().
First use makeqtl() with the chromosome and position of the QTL of interest, to create a "qtl object", and then fitqtl().

karl
